bayts.text: I have stretched my hand to Allah through the Chosen, the Supported,
and He has led me with what most profits, and has been for me with generosity.
The Lord of the heaven and the earth has benefited me with a benefit that has risen high,
and has led to me what He apportioned for me, with munificence.
Toward me my Lord has led a grace that increases my nearness,
by the standing of the best of the Prophets, our Aḥmad, the honoured.
No cause of infirmity has come against me, nor wrath, nor error,
and He Who honours me with the greatest has led to me the best of the lawful.
The praise of the chosen Prophet has driven toward others than me what one guards against,
beforehand; and has led to me the fear of Allah, with a magnified good pleasure.
The service of the best of the worlds has driven toward others than me whoever lies,
and through the Trustworthy (Gabriel) and the Trustworthy (Muḥammad) I have triumphed, without pride.
No unbelief has come against me, nor depravity, nor idolatry, nor
what draws false attribution of words; and Allah has raised my pen high.
The Nourisher (Al-Muqīt) has guarded my person; the times have not headed for my harm,
and for me He leads the best nourishment Who has guarded me from the darknesses.
My writing gives thanks to the Lord of the mighty Throne with well-strung pearls,
and there has yielded to me an immense secret from His Tablet and the Pen.
I have conversed intimately with my Lord for years, and He has led to me the best of supplications,
and I see neither those who moan, nor what draws pain.
My sale (of myself) the Generous has accepted at a price that does not fade (cf. Qurʾān 9:111),
and He leads to me what I long for: knowledge without learning.
My miracle is the writing of my hand, in the service of the Supported one (Muḥammad),
and Allah, the Bestower of generosity, has been for me with what most profits.
